item.title: Historic triumph: India clinch first Squash World Cup title
item.description: Chennai: Hosts India were crowned Squash World Cup champions for the first time after registering a commanding 3–0 victory over top seeds Hong Kong, China, in the final at Express Avenue Mall in Chennai on Sunday. The victory marked a significant moment for Indian squash as the team became only the fifth nation to win a major World Squash team event. item.title: 3rd T20I: Abhishek, Varun power India to seven-wicket win over South Africa, take 2-1 lead
item.description: Dharamsala: In chilly climes and seam-bowling friendly conditions, India registered a comfortable seven-wicket victory over South Africa in the third T20I at the HPCA Stadium in Dharamsala on Sunday, and took a 2-1 lead in the five-match series. After the spinners and seamers combined to bundle out South Africa for 117 in seam-friendly conditions, India chased down 118 with 25 balls to spare. item.title: Mohammed Moquim expelled from Congress over alleged anti-party activities
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The Congress party has expelled former Barabati-Cuttack MLA Mohammed Moquim from its primary membership, citing anti-party activities. The decision was communicated through a notice issued by the Odisha Pradesh Congress Committee (OPCC). The notice, signed by OPCC president Bhakta Charan Das, said the All India Congress Committee had approved the proposal to remove Moquim from the party. item.title: Islamic State hallmarks emerge in Bondi Beach massacre: Attacker is a person of interest
item.description: New Delhi: The shooting at Sydney’s Bondi Beach on Sunday claimed 16 lives, while injuring over 40. The incident occurred when over a crowd of 1,000 had gathered at the venue on the first day of Hanukkah. The two shooters have been identified as 24-year-old male Naveed Akram and 50-year-old Sajid Akram.
